title: Private Northeast Riverfront and Arts Ride in Minneapolis
includes: Fresh BreadHaus pretzel for every guest
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This is a bring-your-own beer and wine ride. We'll have ice on board.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Pedal through one of the most vibrant historic districts on the Private Northeast Riverfront and Arts Ride. Departing from Marshall Street NE, this interactive pedal-powered group adventure allows travelers to work together while cruising past scenic Mississippi riverbanks, eye-catching neighborhood murals, and bustling local hubs. Led by a knowledgeable local driver, your group can sit back, pedal at a comfortable pace, and soak in the creative energy of Northeast Minneapolis while exploring top sights and stopping at neighborhood favorites. We'll stop at iconic, local restaurants offering food and beverages and art stops.
